param: Λ Recruitment/birth rate into child susceptible class S_C
μ Natural death rate (applies to all living compartments)
ξ_M Rate of enrolling susceptible children into monitored vaccination class M_C^V (paper: x_M)
ξ_U Rate of enrolling susceptible children into unmonitored vaccination class U_C^V (paper: x_U)
ψ Maturation/aging rate from child group to adult group (paper: j)
β_C Transmission rate for children (force of infection coefficient for child susceptibles)
β_A Transmission rate for adults (force of infection coefficient for adult susceptibles)
ε Residual susceptibility factor for unmonitored vaccinated individuals; vaccine effectiveness is (1-ε)
η_U Rate of becoming immune from unmonitored vaccinated children U_C^V (paper: h_U)
η_M Rate of becoming immune from monitored vaccinated children M_C^V (paper: h_M)
ξ_A Adult vaccination rate from S_A to V_A (paper: x_A)
η_A Rate of becoming immune from adult vaccination (from V_A and U_A^V to I_mA) (paper: h_A)
δ Progression rate from exposed to infectious (1/incubation period) (paper: d)
γ Recovery rate from infectious to immune (paper: g)
d Disease-induced death rate (paper: d; distinct from δ)
